5 Days Gorilla Trekking Safari in Uganda

Package overview

This 5-day adventure takes you to the world-famous , home to nearly half of the world’s remaining mountain gorillas. You’ll also explore Uganda’s stunning countryside, enjoy optional cultural visits, and experience one of the most powerful wildlife encounters on Earth.

  • Scenic countryside views
  • Equator experience
  • Cultural encounters along the way
  • One hour with mountain gorillas
  • Guided gorilla trekking
  • One hour with mountain gorillas
  • Incredible photography opportunities
  • Relaxation at Lake Bunyonyi

Day-by-day itinerary

01Day 1 | Arrival in Entebbe – Transfer to Kampala

Upon arrival at Entebbe International Airport , you will be welcomed by your guide and transferred to your hotel in Kampala . Relax after your flight Optional city tour depending on arrival time Hotel in Kampala or Entebbe

02Day 2 | Transfer to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park

After breakfast, depart early for Bwindi Impenetrable National Park . Scenic drive through Uganda’s countryside Stop at the Equator crossing for photos Lunch en route in Mbarara Arrive in Bwindi in the evening and check in at your lodge. Lodge near Bwindi

03Day 3 | Gorilla Trekking Experience

This is the highlight of your safari. After an early breakfast, head to the park headquarters for a briefing before entering the forest. Trek through dense rainforest in search of a habituated gorilla family Spend one magical hour observing the gorillas in their natural habitat Experience close encounters with these gentle giants This life-changing experience in Bwindi Impenetrable National Park is often described as one of the most powerful wildlife encounters in the world. Return to the lodge for relaxation. Lodge near Bwindi

04Day 4 | Community Visit or Nature Walk – Transfer to Lake Bunyonyi

After breakfast, enjoy an optional cultural visit to the Batwa community or a guided forest walk. Later, transfer to the beautiful Lake Bunyonyi , known for its scenic islands and tranquil atmosphere. Canoe ride or relaxation by the lake Stunning sunset views Lodge at Lake Bunyonyi

05Day 5 | Return to Entebbe – Departure

After breakfast, begin your journey back to Entebbe . Lunch en route Drop-off at the airport for your departure flight Gorilla Trekking Information Gorilla permits are required and should be booked in advance Minimum age: 15 years Fitness level: Moderate (trekking can be challenging but rewarding)

What's included

  • Gorilla trekking permit
  • Game drives in custom 4x4 vehicles with expert guides
  • Pick-up and drop-off from hotel/airport
  • Accommodation in safari lodge or tented camps
  • Park entry fees
  • Professional English-speaking safari guide/driver
  • Bottled drinking water during the safari

What's excluded

  • Soft drinks, alcoholic beverages, and snacks
  • Personal purchases or souvenirs
  • Optional activities (e.g., guided nature walks, cultural visits)
  • Tips and gratuities for driver/guide
  • Items of personal nature (e.g., jackets, binoculars, cameras)
  • Accommodation before or after the safari
  • Travel insurance or international medical cover

From-prices are planning figures for two adults sharing, in a private vehicle with a guide, at the season shown. Your written quote is the only price that applies. International flights, visas, tips, drinks and gorilla permits are separate unless the quote lists them.
